exposure: established first phase of active labour
Women in the established first phase of active labour and without any signs of fetal growth restriction (FGR) or PE (maternal stress group)
Women with an ultrasound-based diagnosis of FGR, with or without PE (feto-placental stress group)
Women not yet in active labour and without any signs of FGR or PE (control group)
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing amniotomy or caesarean section after 34 gestational weeks
finding: Salivary and maternal blood UA levels were increased in the feto-placental stress group, suggesting a placental origin and potential use of sUA as a biomarker of placental dysfunction, including FGR and severe PE.
